scenario.title: Carrier rejects shipment notices
scenario.initial_request: Let an AI agent auto-fix rejected shipment notices and resubmit them

M-M1.name: rejection_rate
M-M1.numerator: Number of shipment notices rejected by carrier

F-01.statement: Three rejected shipment notices observed: N-1 and N-2 due to LOC_UNKNOWN, N-3 due to EVENT_ORDER.

CL-01.statement: Let an AI agent auto-fix rejected shipment notices and resubmit them

H-ALT-RULE-CHANGE.statement: Carrier updated validation/business rules, causing previously valid notices to be rejected.

U-U1.question: Are LOC_UNKNOWN rejects truly non‑correctable, or could they be fixed with additional data enrichment?
U-U1.decision_impact: Could change whether an AI auto‑fix is viable.
U-U1.resolution_path: Engage carrier to examine LOC_UNKNOWN cases and test if supplemental data (e.g., geolocation lookup) eliminates the reject.
U-U1.safe_placeholder: Continue manual review of LOC_UNKNOWN rejects while investigation proceeds.

U-U2.question: Does simple resubmission resolve EVENT_ORDER rejects, or are they persistent?
U-U2.decision_impact: Determines whether a retry‑only strategy is sufficient.
U-U2.resolution_path: Run a controlled A/B test: resubmit a sample of EVENT_ORDER rejects vs. hold and analyze success rate.
U-U2.safe_placeholder: Do not auto‑resubmit EVENT_ORDER rejects; treat them as requiring manual review.

A-A1.statement: LOC_UNKNOWN and EVENT_ORDER reasons are not correctable data errors.

A-A2.statement: Resubmitting the same notice will not resolve LOC_UNKNOWN or EVENT_ORDER rejects.

SC-S1.statement: Zero rejects due to LOC_UNKNOWN or EVENT_ORDER observed over a rolling 7‑day window.
SC-S1.validation_method: Query reject-log for reason in {LOC_UNKNOWN, EVENT_ORDER} and confirm count = 0.

SC-S2.statement: Overall rejection rate reduced by at least 50% relative to baseline.
SC-S2.validation_method: Compare baseline rejection rate (pre‑intervention) to post‑intervention rate using reject-log counts.

problem_definition.root_problem: Rejected shipment notices occur because carrier validation flags LOC_UNKNOWN or EVENT_ORDER, which are not correctable data errors that an AI agent can fix (E-01).

trace.summary: Rejected shipment notices occur because carrier validation flags LOC_UNKNOWN or EVENT_ORDER, which are not correctable data errors that an AI agent can fix (E-01).
Agent needed to monitor reject reasons, negotiate carrier interface changes, and drive enrichment when possible.

structural_remedies.description: Add upstream data enrichment and validation step to ensure location data completeness and correct event ordering before shipment notice generation.
structural_remedies.rationale: Can be implemented as a lightweight data-quality check within the existing notice generation pipeline; fits within 225 minutes.; residual gap: Effectiveness depends on enrichment completeness; unknown U-U1 indicates LOC_UNKNOWN may not be fully correctable via enrichment alone.

structural_remedies.description: Revise carrier interface agreement to relax LOC_UNKNOWN/EVENT_ORDER validation or implement real-time pre-submission validation with carrier feedback.
structural_remedies.rationale: Contractual or process change can be negotiated quickly; no technical build required.; residual gap: Dependent on carrier acceptance; if carrier declines, the gap remains.

solution_design.why_agent: Agent needed to monitor reject reasons, negotiate carrier interface changes, and drive enrichment when possible.
solution_design.bridge_sunset_condition: If carrier does not agree to revised interface within the remaining 150 minutes, fallback to manual review and pause auto-fix attempts.
